controller_6m.notes: exists=false confirmed. '10.07' returns zero hits across all 502 pages; 'Controlling Shareholder' occurrences are unrelated (regulatory text p94, history p127, non-controlling shareholders pp.254/318, share-scheme text p373, CSRC appendix p413). controller_12m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p278 (key persons + Pathfinder SIIs undertaking under Rules 18C.13/18C.14). DATE CORRECTION: the clause ends 'on the date which is 12 months (or 6 months in the case of the Pathfinder SIIs) from the Listing Date' - explicit inclusive end ON the anniversary (2027-06-26), so first free = 2027-06-27. Candidate's 2027-06-26 made the anniversary itself the free day.

corrections.basis: Chapter 18C: no Rule 10.07 controlling shareholder undertaking; the controller-equivalent lock-up is the key persons' undertaking under Rules 18C.13/18C.14 commencing on the prospectus shareholding-disclosure date (inclusive of Listing Date) and ending 'on the date which is 12 months from the Listing Date' (inclusive end ON the anniversary); first free day = anniversary + 1 = 2027-06-27.
